title: Gemini Recalls Power Adaptor/Chargers Due to Burn Hazard
summary: The adaptors can overheat, posing a burn hazard. Units: About 31,000.

title: Lifeguard Press Recalls Charging Kits Due to Fire, Shock Hazards
summary: The wall charger can overheat and emit smoke and sparks, posing fire and burn hazards to consumers. The prongs on the charger can detach and remain in the electrical outlet, posing a risk of electrical shock. Units: About 25,400.

title: Master Cutlery Recalls Neck Knives Due to Laceration Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Big 5 Sports
summary: The sheath does not hold the knife securely, allowing the knife to fall out of the sheath unexpectedly. This poses a risk of laceration to the consumer. Units: About 4,000.

title: Big Fireworks Recalls Mock Sword Fireworks Devices Due to Impact, Burn Hazards
summary: The handheld fountain device can unexpectedly explode, posing a risk of impact and burn to the user. Units: About 1,040 units.

title: All Power America Recalls Snow Throwers Due to Fire Hazard
summary: Exposure to Chinese gasoline for extended periods of time while testing the product overseas caused the carburetor needle to become corroded and allow fuel to leak, posing a fire hazard to consumers. Units: About 10,000.

title: Porter-Cable Fixed-Base Production Routers Recalled Due to Electrical Shock Hazard
summary: The router base handles are not insulated, posing an electric shock hazard. Units: About 100,000 in the United States and about 7,800 in Canada.

title: Sony Recalls VAIO Flip PC Laptops Due to Fire and Burn Hazards
summary: The computers' lithium-ion batteries can overheat, posing fire and burn hazards. Units: About 680.

title: Far East Brokers Recall Glass Beverage Dispenser Set Due to Injury Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Publix
summary: The metal stand supporting the glass dispenser can break, posing an injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 4,000.

title: Mayborn USA Recalls to Repair Baby Monitors Due to Strangulation Hazard
summary: Child can pull sensor pad cord into crib and wrap around the neck, posing a strangulation hazard. Units: About 25,000 in the U.S. and 3,500 in Canada.

title: Metabo Recalls Electric Angle Grinders Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The on/off switch can stick in the "On" position, posing a laceration hazard. Units: About 4,300.

title: Dream On Me Recalls High Chairs Due to Strangulation and Fall Hazards
summary: The leg or side opening of the chair can allow a child's body to pass through and become entrapped at the neck or fall from the chair. This poses a strangulation and fall hazard to young children. Units: About 2,800.

title: East Coast Cycle Supply Recalls Trayl TRN Mountain Bikes Due to Crash Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Sports Authority (Recall Alert)
summary: The brakes can fail to stop riders within the distances required by federal regulation, posing a crash hazard. Units: About 1,800.

title: Pottery Barn Recalls Bar Stools Due to Fall Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The bar stool footrest can break, posing a fall hazard to the user. Units: About 1,000.

title: Oeuf Recalls to Repair Cribs Due to Entrapment Hazard
summary: The slats/spindles and top rail can detach from the cribs and pose an entrapment hazard to a child. Units: About 14,000.

title: Cycling Sports Group Recalls GT Brand Mountain Bicycles Due to Crash, Injury Hazards
summary: The wheel hubs can break and cause the brake system to fail, posing crash and injury hazards to the consumer. Units: About 120 in the U.S. and 32 in Canada.

title: Popkiller Recalls USB Chargers, Adapters and Cables Due to Fire and Electric Shock Hazards
summary: Improperly mounted plug blades, and inadequate electronic circuitry create a fire and electrical shock hazard to consumers. Units: About 2,500.

title: Nantucket Distributing Recalls Outdoor Patio Set Chairs Due to Fall Hazard
summary: The rear legs of the chair can break, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 4,000.

title: Bollinger Fitness Recalls Resistance Bands Due to Injury Hazard
summary: A black plastic ball attached to the resistance band's door anchor can unexpectedly release and strike the user, posing an injury hazard to consumers. Units: About 60,000 in the U.S. and 3,000 in Canada.

title: Halco Recalls LED Bulbs Due to Risk of Injury and Burn Hazards
summary: The LED bulbs can overheat and fall onto consumers below, posing impact and burn hazards. Units: About 9,500.

title: GSK Recalls Panadol Advance Bottles Due to Failure to Meet Child-Resistant Closure Requirement; Sold Exclusively in Puerto Rico
summary: The packaging is not child-resistant as required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act. These products contain acetaminophen which is required by the Poison Prevention Packaging Act to be sealed with child-resistant packaging. Units: About 10,600.

title: Dynacraft Recalls Avigo Youth Bicycles Due to Fall Hazard; Sold Exclusively at Toys "R" Us
summary: The front wheel on the bicycle can detach, posing a fall hazard. Units: About 3,100.

title: Harris Products Group Recalls Welding Torch Handles Due to Fire Hazard
summary: The torch handles can leak oxygen or fuel, posing a fire hazard. Units: About 13,000 in the U.S. and 350 in Canada.

title: Kawasaki Recalls Teryx4 Recreational Off-highway Vehicles Due to Injury Hazard (Recall Alert)
summary: The vehicle's floor boards can allow a stick or other debris to break through and protrude into the foot rest area, posing an injury hazard to the operator and front passenger. Units: About 11,000.

title: Philips Lighting Recalls Lightolier Glass Lenses Due to Laceration Hazard
summary: The decorative glass lens can shatter and result in falling pieces of glass, posing a risk of laceration to the consumer. Units: About 7,500.
